name: Batik
desc: Wax-resist batik cloth: a kawung quatrefoil field in cream on soga-brown or indigo, threaded everywhere by a fine dark crackle-vein network where the cracked wax let dye seep in, wet beads of pooled dye perpetually creeping along the veins as the colour develops in slow sweeps.

style.doc: palette: soga brown / indigo blue / bright peranakan / wax-heavy dark negative / muted hand-drawn
